meta.name: exec-briefing-memo
meta.description: Decision needed + recommendation + evidence + tradeoffs, 把复杂材料压成可拍板的一页

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂材料压成可拍板的一页简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速从长篇材料提炼决策要点
copy.tagline_en: Condense complex materials into a one-page decision memo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly distill key decision points from lengthy materials

howto.what: 把长会议记录、调研材料、销售反馈等压成一页决策简报:写清待拍板的问题、明确建议(含信心等级)、5-7 条带来源标注的事实、方案对比表、风险与缓解、下一步。
howto.when: 当你给出长会议记录、调研材料或销售反馈等复杂材料,需要一个能 3 分钟拍板的决策框架时,它接管输出。

say.text: 把这些会议记录压成一页决策简报,推荐动作要明确。
say.note: 按模板输出 memo、权衡表和风险

say.text: 用 decision-command 深色风格做这份 go/no-go 简报。
say.note: 切换到紧急决策的风格模板

say.text: 材料里缺预算数据,请标出 Evidence gaps。
say.note: 缺的关键信息会单列出来

howto.what_en: Claude turns long meeting notes, research or sales feedback into a one-page decision memo: the decision needed, a recommendation with confidence level, 5-7 key facts with source tags, a tradeoff table, risks and next actions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you hand over long meeting notes, research or sales feedback and need a single decision framed for sign-off; it takes over the output.

say_en.text: Compress these meeting notes into a one-page decision memo.
Use the decision-command style for this go/no-go briefing.
say_en.note: Switches to the dark command template

say_en.text: Flag the missing budget data in Evidence gaps.
